# Skills and tools reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_skill_reference.py. Don't edit by hand. -->

WinAuto has **26 skills** with **123 tools**. The AI model sees each tool's name, description and parameters, and picks the ones a request needs. Tools marked **asks first** show an approval card before they run.

To add your own, see [Adding a skill](adding-a-skill.md).

## apps

Open, close, switch between and list apps.

- **`close_app`**: Close an app's windows normally (the app can still ask to save).
  - `name` (string): The app's everyday name, or words from the window title
- **`find_installed_app`**: Check whether an app is installed, or list installed apps matching some words.
  - `query` (string): App name or words to look for
- **`force_close_app`** · **asks first**: Force an app to quit immediately. Unsaved work is lost. Only use when asked to force close or kill.
  - `name` (string): The app's everyday name
- **`list_open_apps`**: List the apps that currently have open windows.
- **`open_app`**: Open (launch) an app on this PC, or bring it to the front if it's already open.
  - `name` (string): The app's everyday name, e.g. 'spotify', 'chrome', 'vs code', 'calculator'
- **`switch_to_app`**: Bring an open app's window to the front.
  - `name` (string): App name or window title words

## notes

Notes and todo list.

- **`add_note`**: Save a note.
  - `text` (string): What to write down
  - `title` (string; optional): Optional short title
- **`add_todo`**: Add a todo / task to the list.
  - `task` (string): What needs doing
  - `due` (string; optional): When it's due, in plain words (e.g. 'tomorrow 5pm', 'friday') or ISO date. Optional.
  - `priority` (string; one of `normal`, `high`; optional, default `'normal'`): 'high' for important ones
- **`append_to_note`**: Add text to the end of an existing note.
  - `note_id` (integer): The note's number
  - `text` (string): Text to add
- **`clear_done_todos`** · **asks first**: Remove all finished todos from the list.
- **`complete_todo`**: Mark a todo as done.
  - `todo` (string): The todo's number (e.g. 3 or #3) or some of its words
- **`delete_note`** · **asks first**: Delete a note.
  - `note_id` (integer): The note's number
- **`delete_todo`** · **asks first**: Delete a todo.
  - `todo` (string): The todo's number or words
- **`list_notes`**: Show the most recent notes.
  - `limit` (integer; optional, default `10`): How many (default 10)
- **`list_todos`**: Show todos.
  - `which` (string; one of `open`, `today`, `overdue`, `upcoming`, `done`, `all`; optional, default `'open'`): open (default), today, overdue, upcoming (next 7 days), done, or all
- **`read_note`**: Show one note in full.
  - `note_id` (integer): The note's number
- **`search_notes`**: Search notes by words. Use this to answer questions about things the user saved earlier.
  - `query` (string): Words to look for
- **`update_todo`**: Change a todo's text or due date.
  - `todo` (string): The todo's number or words
  - `text` (string; optional): New text (optional)
  - `due` (string; optional): New due date in plain words, or 'none' to clear it (optional)

## web

Open websites, search the web, read pages, weather.

- **`get_weather`**: Current weather and forecast.
  - `location` (string; optional): City or place. Leave empty for the user's saved or current location.
- **`open_website`**: Open a website in the browser.
  - `site` (string): A site name (e.g. 'youtube', 'gmail') or a web address
- **`read_webpage`**: Read the text of a web page so you can answer from it.
  - `url` (string): The page address
- **`search_site`**: Search inside a specific site (youtube, amazon, wikipedia, github, reddit, maps, images, news, spotify...) in the browser.
  - `site` (string): Which site
  - `query` (string): What to search for
- **`search_web`**: Search the web. By default the results come back to you so you can answer the question. Set open_in_browser=true only if the user wants to see the search page.
  - `query` (string): What to search for
  - `open_in_browser` (boolean; optional, default `False`): Show the results in the browser instead

## utils

Calculator, unit conversion, world clock.

- **`calculate`**: Calculate a math expression (supports + - * / ^ %, 'of', sqrt, sin...).
  - `expression` (string): e.g. '15% of 2400', '(12+8)*3', 'sqrt(144)'
- **`convert_units`**: Convert between units (length, weight, volume, speed, data, area, time, temperature).
  - `value` (number): The number
  - `from_unit` (string): e.g. 'km', 'lb', 'F'
  - `to_unit` (string): e.g. 'miles', 'kg', 'C'
- **`time_in`**: Current time in a city or country.
  - `place` (string): City or country, e.g. 'Tokyo', 'New York'

## system

PC controls: volume, brightness, theme, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, power, battery, health.

- **`battery_status`**: Battery level and whether it's charging.
- **`bluetooth`**: Turn Bluetooth on or off.
  - `on` (boolean): true for on, false for off
- **`cancel_shutdown`**: Cancel a scheduled shutdown or restart.
- **`change_brightness`**: Make the screen brighter or dimmer.
  - `change` (integer; optional, default `15`): Percent to change, negative for dimmer
- **`change_volume`**: Turn the volume up or down by some amount.
  - `change` (integer; optional, default `10`): Percent to change, negative for down (e.g. 10 or -10)
- **`dark_mode`**: Switch Windows between dark mode and light mode.
  - `on` (boolean; optional, default `True`): true for dark mode, false for light mode
- **`empty_recycle_bin`** · **asks first**: Empty the Recycle Bin (permanent).
- **`lock_pc`**: Lock the PC.
- **`mute`**: Mute or unmute the sound.
  - `mute` (boolean; optional, default `True`): true to mute, false to unmute
- **`open_settings`**: Open a page of Windows Settings.
  - `page` (string; optional): e.g. wifi, bluetooth, display, sound, battery, windows update, background, storage, apps
- **`pc_status`**: PC health: CPU, memory, disk space, uptime, and what's using the most memory.
- **`power_off`** · **asks first**: Shut down, restart or sign out of the PC.
  - `action` (string; one of `shutdown`, `restart`, `signout`; optional, default `'shutdown'`): shutdown, restart or signout
  - `minutes` (integer; optional, default `0`): Delay in minutes (0 = now)
- **`set_brightness`**: Set screen brightness (laptop screens) from 0 to 100.
  - `level` (integer): 0-100
- **`set_volume`**: Set the volume to a level from 0 to 100.
  - `level` (integer): 0-100
- **`sleep_pc`** · **asks first**: Put the PC to sleep.
- **`wifi`**: Turn Wi-Fi on or off.
  - `on` (boolean): true for on, false for off

## contacts

Contact book.

- **`add_contact`**: Save a contact (or add details to an existing one with the same name).
  - `name` (string): Full name
  - `email` (string; optional): Email address
  - `phone` (string; optional): Phone number with country code if known
  - `discord` (string; optional): Discord username
  - `nickname` (string; optional): What you call them, e.g. 'mom'
- **`delete_contact`** · **asks first**: Delete a contact.
  - `name` (string): Who
- **`find_contact`**: Look up a contact's details.
  - `name` (string): Name, nickname, email or number
- **`import_contacts`**: Import contacts from a .vcf (vCard) or .csv file, e.g. exported from Google Contacts or Outlook.
  - `path` (string): Full path to the file
- **`list_contacts`**: List all contacts.
- **`update_contact`**: Change one detail of a contact.
  - `name` (string): Who
  - `field` (string; one of `email`, `phone`, `discord`, `nickname`, `name`): Which detail
  - `value` (string; optional): New value (empty to remove)

## reminders

Reminders and timers.

- **`cancel_reminder`**: Cancel a reminder or timer.
  - `which` (string): Its number (e.g. 4) or some of its words, or 'timer' for the timer
- **`list_reminders`**: Show upcoming reminders and running timers.
- **`set_reminder`**: Set a reminder that pops up as a notification.
  - `text` (string): What to remind about
  - `when` (string): When, in plain words: 'in 20 minutes', 'tomorrow 9am', 'friday 5pm'
  - `repeat` (string; one of `none`, `daily`, `weekdays`, `weekly`, `monthly`; optional, default `'none'`): none, daily, weekdays, weekly or monthly
- **`set_timer`**: Start a countdown timer.
  - `duration` (string): e.g. '10 minutes', '1h30m', '90 seconds'
  - `label` (string; optional): Optional name, e.g. 'pasta'

## email

Gmail: send, check, read, reply.

- **`check_email`**: List recent emails in the inbox. Supports Gmail search words, e.g. 'from:ram', 'subject:invoice', 'newer_than:2d'.
  - `query` (string; optional): Gmail search (optional)
  - `unread_only` (boolean; optional, default `True`): Only unread ones (default true)
  - `limit` (integer; optional, default `5`): How many (default 5)
- **`read_email`**: Read one email in full.
  - `email_id` (string): The number shown in check_email, e.g. 1234
- **`reply_email`** · **asks first**: Reply to an email. The user sees and can edit it before it goes.
  - `email_id` (string): The email's number
  - `body` (string): The reply text
- **`send_email`** · **asks first**: Send an email from the user's Gmail. The user sees and can edit it before it goes.
  - `to` (string): Contact names or email addresses, comma separated
  - `subject` (string): Subject line
  - `body` (string): The full email text
  - `cc` (string; optional): Optional names/addresses to copy in

## whatsapp

WhatsApp messages.

- **`open_whatsapp_chat`**: Open a WhatsApp chat with someone without sending anything.
  - `to` (string): Contact name or phone number
- **`send_whatsapp`** · **asks first**: Send a WhatsApp message. The user sees and can edit it first.
  - `to` (string): Contact name or phone number
  - `message` (string): The message text

## discord

Discord direct messages.

- **`open_discord_chat`**: Open a Discord chat with someone without sending anything.
  - `to` (string): Contact, username or #channel
- **`send_discord`** · **asks first**: Send a Discord direct message (or a message in a #channel of the open server). The user approves it first.
  - `to` (string): Contact name, Discord username, or #channel
  - `message` (string): The message

## files

Open folders, find and open files, tidy Downloads.

- **`create_folder`**: Create a new folder.
  - `name` (string): Folder name
  - `location` (string; optional, default `'desktop'`): Where (default desktop)
- **`delete_file`** · **asks first**: Move a file or folder to the Recycle Bin. Needs a full path (use find_files first).
  - `path` (string): Full path
- **`find_files`**: Find files by name in your usual folders (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, Videos, Music, OneDrive).
  - `query` (string): Words from the file name
  - `kind` (string; optional): Optional: image, video, audio, pdf, document, spreadsheet, presentation, archive, installer, code
  - `folder` (string; optional): Optional folder to look in, e.g. downloads
- **`largest_files`**: List the biggest files in a folder (to free up space).
  - `folder` (string; optional, default `'downloads'`): Folder name or path (default downloads)
  - `limit` (integer; optional, default `10`): How many
- **`open_file`**: Open a file with its usual app. Takes a full path or words from the file name.
  - `file` (string): Full path, or words from the name
  - `kind` (string; optional): Optional kind to narrow the search
- **`open_folder`**: Open a folder in File Explorer.
  - `folder` (string): desktop, downloads, documents, pictures, music, videos, screenshots, or a full path
- **`organize_downloads`** · **asks first**: Tidy the Downloads folder into subfolders by type (Images, Documents, Videos, Music, Archives, Installers, Code, Other).
- **`recent_files`**: Show recently used files, or the newest files in a folder.
  - `folder` (string; optional): Optional folder (e.g. downloads) to list newest files from
  - `limit` (integer; optional, default `10`): How many

## clipboard

Read and set the clipboard; clipboard history.

- **`clipboard_history`**: Show recently copied text (this session).
  - `limit` (integer; optional, default `10`): How many
- **`copy_from_history`**: Copy an item from the clipboard history again.
  - `number` (integer): Its number in the history list
- **`get_clipboard`**: Get the text currently on the clipboard (what the user copied).
- **`set_clipboard`**: Put text on the clipboard so the user can paste it.
  - `text` (string): The text to copy

## media

Media controls and playing music.

- **`next_track`**: Skip to the next track.
- **`now_playing`**: What song or video is playing right now.
- **`play_music`**: Play a song, artist, playlist or video. YouTube plays the top result straight away; Spotify opens its search.
  - `query` (string): What to play
  - `service` (string; one of `default`, `youtube`, `spotify`; optional, default `'default'`): youtube or spotify (default: the user's setting)
- **`play_pause`**: Pause or resume whatever is playing (music, videos).
- **`previous_track`**: Go back to the previous track.

## windows

Arrange windows and take screenshots.

- **`arrange_window`**: Snap, maximize, minimize or restore a window.
  - `position` (string; one of `left`, `right`, `top`, `bottom`, `top left`, `top right`, `bottom left`, `bottom right`, `center`, `maximize`, `minimize`, `restore`): left, right, top, bottom, top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right, center, maximize, minimize, restore
  - `app` (string; optional): App name; empty = the window in use before WinAuto opened
- **`show_desktop`**: Minimize every window to show the desktop, or bring them back.
  - `restore` (boolean; optional, default `False`): true to bring the windows back
- **`side_by_side`**: Put two apps side by side (first on the left, second on the right).
  - `left_app` (string): App for the left half
  - `right_app` (string): App for the right half
- **`take_screenshot`**: Take a screenshot and save it to Pictures\Screenshots. 'snip' lets the user draw a box (copied to clipboard).
  - `what` (string; one of `screen`, `window`, `snip`; optional, default `'screen'`): screen (all monitors), window (the window in use), or snip

## routines

Saved routines that run several commands.

- **`create_routine`**: Save a routine: a name and the simple commands it runs, in order.
  - `name` (string): e.g. 'work mode'
  - `steps` (list of string): Commands, e.g. ['open vs code', 'open slack', 'volume 20']
- **`delete_routine`** · **asks first**: Delete a routine.
  - `name` (string): The routine's name
- **`list_routines`**: List saved routines.
- **`run_routine`**: Run a saved routine.
  - `name` (string): The routine's name

## shortcuts

Quick links and text snippets.

- **`add_quicklink`**: Save a quick link. Put {query} in the address where search words should go.
  - `name` (string): Short name, e.g. 'gh' or 'jira'
  - `url` (string): e.g. https://github.com/search?q={query}
- **`add_snippet`**: Save a text snippet to paste later (addresses, replies you type often...).
  - `name` (string): Short name, e.g. 'address'
  - `text` (string): The text. May use {date}, {time}, {clipboard}.
- **`delete_quicklink`** · **asks first**: Delete a quick link.
  - `name` (string): Its name
- **`delete_snippet`** · **asks first**: Delete a snippet.
  - `name` (string): Its name
- **`list_quicklinks`**: List saved quick links.
- **`list_snippets`**: List saved snippets.
- **`open_quicklink`**: Open a saved quick link.
  - `name` (string): The quick link's name
  - `query` (string; optional): Words for {query}, if it takes any
- **`paste_snippet`**: Paste a saved snippet into the app you were using (also leaves it on the clipboard).
  - `name` (string): The snippet's name

## tools

Passwords, emoji, colours, network info, terminal commands, temp cleanup.

- **`clean_temp_files`** · **asks first**: Delete temporary files older than a day to free up space.
- **`convert_color`**: Convert a colour between hex, rgb and hsl.
  - `color` (string): e.g. '#ff8800', 'rgb(255, 136, 0)'
- **`find_emoji`**: Find an emoji by name and copy it.
  - `name` (string): e.g. 'party', 'thumbs up', 'fire'
- **`generate_password`**: Generate a strong random password and copy it.
  - `length` (integer; optional, default `16`): How many characters (default 16)
  - `symbols` (boolean; optional, default `True`): Include symbols (default true)
- **`network_info`**: Show this PC's network details: local IP, public IP, Wi-Fi network name.
- **`pick_color`**: Pick the colour under the mouse pointer after a short delay, and copy its hex code.
  - `delay_seconds` (integer; optional, default `3`): Seconds to wait so you can point at the colour (default 3)
- **`run_command`** · **asks first**: Run a command in the terminal (cmd, or PowerShell if it starts with 'ps ') and show its output.
  - `command` (string): The command to run

## memory

Facts about the user to remember across conversations.

- **`forget_fact`**: Forget something you were told to remember.
  - `fact` (string): Words from the fact to forget
- **`list_memories`**: List everything you've been asked to remember.
- **`remember_fact`**: Remember a fact about the user for future conversations.
  - `fact` (string): e.g. 'My sister's name is Sita'

## textactions

Rewrite, fix, shorten, translate, summarize or explain text.

- **`replace_selection`**: Paste text over the selection in the app the user was using.
  - `text` (string): The new text
- **`transform_text`**: Transform text: fix grammar, make formal/casual/shorter/longer, summarize, bullet points, translate, explain, or draft a reply. Leave text empty to use the user's selected or copied text.
  - `action` (string; one of `fix`, `formal`, `casual`, `shorter`, `longer`, `summarize`, `bullets`, `translate`, `explain`, `reply`, `custom`; optional, default `'fix'`): fix, formal, casual, shorter, longer, summarize, bullets, translate, explain, reply, or custom
  - `text` (string; optional): The text (optional)
  - `instruction` (string; optional): For 'custom': what to do with the text
  - `language` (string; optional, default `'English'`): For 'translate': target language

## vision

Answer questions about the screen or an image (local vision model).

- **`ask_about_image`**: Answer a question about an image file.
  - `path` (string): Full path to the image
  - `question` (string; optional, default `'Describe this image.'`): What to find out
- **`ask_about_screen`**: Look at the user's screen (or the window they were using) and answer a question about it.
  - `question` (string; optional, default `"What's on my screen?"`): What to find out, e.g. 'what does this error mean?'
  - `what` (string; one of `screen`, `window`; optional, default `'screen'`): screen or window
- **`read_screen_text`**: Read all the text on the screen (like OCR) and copy it.
  - `what` (string; one of `screen`, `window`; optional, default `'screen'`): screen or window

## info

Currency rates, word definitions, Wikipedia summaries, news headlines.

- **`convert_currency`**: Convert money between currencies with today's rates.
  - `amount` (number): How much
  - `from_currency` (string): e.g. USD, euros, rupees
  - `to_currency` (string): e.g. NPR, INR
- **`define_word`**: Define an English word.
  - `word` (string): The word
- **`get_news`**: Latest news headlines, optionally about a topic.
  - `topic` (string; optional): Optional topic
  - `count` (integer; optional, default `6`): How many (default 6)
- **`wikipedia_summary`**: Get a short Wikipedia summary of a topic.
  - `topic` (string): Person, place, thing or idea

## calendar

Your agenda: synced calendars (read-only) and local events.

- **`add_event`**: Add an event to the local calendar, with a reminder 10 minutes before.
  - `title` (string): What it is
  - `when` (string): Start, e.g. 'friday 3pm'
  - `duration_minutes` (integer; optional, default `60`): Length (default 60)
  - `remind` (boolean; optional, default `True`): Add a reminder (default true)
- **`delete_event`** · **asks first**: Delete a local calendar event.
  - `title` (string): Words from the event's title
- **`get_agenda`**: Show events for a day.
  - `day` (string; optional, default `'today'`): today, tomorrow, a weekday or a date (default today)
- **`next_event`**: What's the next event coming up.

## briefing

Daily briefing.

- **`daily_briefing`**: A briefing for today: weather, calendar, todos, reminders, unread email and top news.
  - `include_news` (boolean; optional, default `True`): Add top headlines (default true)

## focus

Focus sessions (Pomodoro) that minimise distracting apps.

- **`focus_status`**: How much time is left in the focus session.
- **`start_focus`**: Start a focus session (Pomodoro). Distracting apps get minimised until it ends.
  - `minutes` (integer; optional, default `25`): Work length (default 25)
  - `rounds` (integer; optional, default `1`): How many work rounds (default 1)
  - `break_minutes` (integer; optional, default `5`): Break between rounds (default 5)
  - `block_apps` (list of string; optional): Apps to keep away (default: your list in Settings)
- **`stop_focus`**: Stop the focus session.

## voice

Read text aloud.

- **`read_aloud`**: Read text aloud. Leave text empty to read the selected or copied text.
  - `text` (string; optional): What to read
- **`stop_speaking`**: Stop reading aloud.

## help

What WinAuto can do, with examples to type.

- **`show_help`**: Show what WinAuto can do, with examples the user can type.
  - `topic` (string; optional): Optional: apps, todos, reminders, email, messages, pc, web, files, writing or quick
